questions.question: Why does `build_runtime_receipt()` run `jax.pmap` across `jax.local_devices()` and call `jax.block_until_ready` instead of only checking `jax.default_backend()`?
options: Because `jax.pmap` + `jax.block_until_ready` proves that `libtpu` compiled and executed a multi-device XLA computation across every local chip and returned the expected numerical result
Because `jax.pmap` automatically deletes the Cloud TPU VM
questions.explanation: A synchronized `pmap` reduction tests compilation, HBM allocation, and execution across all local devices rather than just querying a string.
